data.troubleshooting: The upstream API returned an error for dataset 'NAS' with filters: base_year=2022-23, series=Current, frequency_code=Quarterly, indicator_code=1,5, year=2025-26,2024-25. Common causes: 1) indicator_code or other numeric codes are out of range. 2) Non-integer values like '1.0', 'abc', or empty strings in numeric fields. 3) Comma-separated values where only single values are accepted (e.g. PLFS indicator_code).
data.suggestion: Call get_indicators(dataset='NAS') to check valid codes, then get_metadata() for filter values.
